issues.rationale: The original and revised BRIEF both require distinct waiting/ready/requested/blocked status fills. The revised reference assigns #FFFFE5B3 to both Wi-Fi required and Storage needed across P1/P2, while palette.waiting (#FFE9EFF8) is never exercised by any status-fill assertion. An implementation following this reference can pass the runtime style rules without rendering the distinct waiting role. Source review cannot cure a missing rendered-color expectation.
issues.required_resolution: Independently resolve the status-to-role mapping while preserving the original distinct-role requirement; pin revised expectations/references/policy/lock and reconstruct all affected plans before implementation. Do not accept source-only evidence as rendered color proof.

issues.rationale: The original API mandates exact exported model/component declarations and iOS14 compatibility. The source index has only a generic production-component proposition for this surface. The thin bridge does not test Swift model Equatable/Identifiable conformances or every public stored value, Kotlin data-class semantics or modifier parameter, and the frozen iOS observer targets iOS17. Those original MUSTs therefore have no explicit source-index route capable of closing them.
issues.required_resolution: Add independently fixed atomic source propositions for the exact exported declaration/compatibility clauses not exercised by the host. Bind future judgments to the existing exact production paths and actual source bytes/lines; retain runtime checks separately.

issues.rationale: The API separately requires noninteractive canvas/surface/ink carriers and a primary label filling its native rectangular allocation with matching content shape. Current native checks cover labels, selected/enabled state, geometry and sampled fill; source propositions cover preservation and identity, but do not assert these remaining source-level construction/interaction constraints. They cannot be inferred from a pixel fill or measured AX control height.
issues.required_resolution: Provide explicit independently typed source-audit routes for the noninteraction/content-shape construction clauses, without recasting actual size, spacing, fill or runtime reachability as source evidence.
